summary: Verified share/OG title fixes (bracketed factory codes, production years, 'All New' prefix, submodel+trim inclusion, Cyrillic trim leakage) via new pytest suite hitting /api/share/car and /api/share/track against the preview URL, plus a Playwright browser check of /bg/car/42354550 and /bg/car/42254427. All 11 backend tests passed and both browser cases render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3994 lines - consider modularising (share endpoints, image proxy, title helpers) into separate modules for maintainability.

_share_title correctly handles PO536/(2019-)/All New/Hangul/duplicate parts; a small improvement would be to also short-circuit when parts is empty at the end and fall back to raw manufacturer+model to avoid a completely empty preview title (currently the endpoint caller already falls back to 'Europe Encar').
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_share_titles.py covers Cayenne (42354550, no PO536/years), Tucson (42416001, All New stripped, upstream may return nulls so 'Tucson' presence is soft-skipped), Morning (42422490, (JA) stripped), Sportage (42254427, submodel+trim), AMG GT (42174617), no-Cyrillic (42072910), og:description/image proxy (42259236), track share (271191199/bol), and normal-vs-crawler UA routing on /bg/car/42354550. Browser verification confirms document.title='Porsche Cayenne 3.0 Coupe · Encar', og:title identical, og:image populated, H1 keeps '(PO536)' by design. For /bg/car/42254427 the visible subtitle reads 'Diesel 2WD TLX · Top Grade' (English) and og:title reads 'Kia Sportage R Diesel 2WD TLX Top Grade · Encar'.
rca of the issue: N/A - all reported title bugs are fixed. _title_part() strips brackets and 'All New' prefix; _share_title() drops Hangul, purely-parenthetical filler and duplicate parts; CarDetailPage builds seoTitle from titleModel(car.title)+grade+badge_detail so the browser meta title mirrors the share endpoint. H1 intentionally keeps the years/generation code via stripGenerationYears usage on the visible heading only.
